cues: A carpenter marks a pilot hole before seating a threaded fastener in the new shelf support.
A child assembles a birdhouse, joining its wooden panels with small threaded fasteners at each corner.
Before applying varnish, the restorer removes the cabinet pull by backing out two tiny threaded fasteners.
The gardener waters seedlings at dawn, checking each pot for dry soil before the sun grows stronger.
At low tide, silver crabs cross wet sand while small waves recede from the shoreline.
The baker waits for dough to rise before shaping it into rolls for the afternoon meal.
